caption: The drawing depicts a stylized horse facing left, rendered in shades of gray with numerous evenly spaced red spots across its body and legs. The mane is short and outlined in a dark gray, while the tail is long, curved, and colored reddish-brown with black spots. The horse has a light pink inner ear with two pink stripes, a simple black bridle running from its mouth to behind its ears, and a yellow and gray saddle with one stirrup visible. The hooves and lower legs are marked with darker gray. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Toy Horse
